description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Activate Garruk's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to draw cards equal to the Fractal's power, thus causing you to draw your entire library.

uses.name: Garruk, Primal Hunter
uses.cardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it
